verdict.why: The Right build shows the stave-church cues the brief names (carved dragon-head projections at the eaves and gables, stone base with a stone-faced gallery, stacked tiers with a stone-capped roof), so it reads more clearly as a Norwegian stave church, while the Left build reads as a generic stacked pagoda with a plain spire and no dragon heads; but the Right build's craft is messier, with scattered, disordered roof pieces and gaps in its tiers, whereas the Left build's massing and roof stepping are cleaner and more coherent.
